title: Doom The Way it Was Meant to Be Played - v1.1 Multi-monitor
summary: Tech Tangents sets up original Doom's three-screen multi-monitor mode, which required a separate networked computer for each monitor. The video covers the hardware and setup work and the result.
why: HN references it as a demonstration of Doom's original multi-monitor support and as retro computing content.

quote.text: There's (at least) one video on Youtube showing it in action with 3 monitors plus a fourth one with the map
